propositions: The deprecated resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) must be hard-removed from schema and tombstoned as warn-class to maintain backward compatibility with existing configs.

Both the schema field definitions and their _as_str_list coercer entries must be deleted from _config_schema.py, and the deprecation registry rows must be replaced with historical tombstone entries in _deprecations.py.
Environment variable twins (REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES and REBAR_RECONCILER_RESOLVED_STATUSES) must be tombstoned warn-class to handle configs that set these via environment.
Documentation references to resolved_statuses must be removed from config.md and user-guide.md; removal must be recorded in release-notes.md and CHANGELOG.md.
All configuration gates, linting, type-checking, and pytest tests must pass; the config-read gate must report zero orphaned read-via markers.
